title: Rating Schedule of the Travel Protection Plans
content:
The rating figures below are the ones the Travel Protection Plans are rated on. Each plan carries its own
base rate, its own flat annual premium where it is a multi-trip plan, its own floor, its own issue fee and its
own loading percentages; the figures of one plan are never read across to another.

## Rates, floors and fees

| Plan | Base rate on the declared trip cost | Flat annual premium | Minimum premium | Policy fee | Destination loading |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 4.2% | 0 | 39 | 12 | 25% |
| Trip Basics Standard | 5.4% | 0 | 55 | 12 | 22% |
| TripGuard Plus | 6.8% | 0 | 79 | 15 | 20% |
| TripGuard Premier | 8.5% | 0 | 109 | 15 | 18% |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 11.9% | 0 | 169 | 25 | 18% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 0% | 289 | 289 | 25 | 25% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 0% | 649 | 649 | 35 | 20% |

Amounts are in USD. A base rate of 0% and a flat annual premium above nothing together mark the two
Annual Multi-Trip plans, which are not rated on a declared trip cost; on those two plans the minimum premium
and the flat annual premium are the same figure, 289 on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller and 649 on
Annual Multi-Trip Executive.

## Age loading ladder, by the age of the oldest insured traveller

| Plan | Under 36 | 36 to 55 | 56 to 65 | 66 to 75 | 76 and over |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 0% | 15% | 45% | 95% | 175% |
| Trip Basics Standard | 0% | 12% | 40% | 85% | 160% |
| TripGuard Plus | 0% | 10% | 35% | 75% | 145% |
| TripGuard Premier | 0% | 8% | 30% | 65% | 130% |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 0% | 8% | 28% | 60% | 120% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 0% | 15% | 50% | 110% | 200% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 0% | 12% | 42% | 90% | 170% |

Read as a sentence, the TripGuard Premier row says that a party whose oldest traveller is 58 attracts a loading
of 30% of the base premium, that the same party on Trip Basics Essential attracts 45%, and that no plan loads
a party whose oldest traveller is 35 or younger at all. The heaviest loading in the range is the 200% carried by
Annual Multi-Trip Traveller for a traveller of 76 or over; the lightest above nothing is the 8% carried by
TripGuard Premier and Cancel For Any Reason Elite for the 36 to 55 band.
